verdicts.decision_note: The client identifies an implementation-relevant minimum-width rule for the VBUS, +5V, and BAT- PCB power paths.

The client replaces the rigid trace-width criterion with concrete current-path acceptance conditions requiring contiguous copper pours without bottlenecks and sufficient stitching vias for VBUS and BAT-.
Target-specific implementation claim that the existing battery traces support 2.5 A; it is the first claimed-working state after the routing criteria were specified.
